rows.en: H-hey? Hello? Anybody there?
You did it now, you bastard!
I never asked for backup!
Tch. Just small fry to slow me down?
rows.notes: Whisper wrote ashi-tama-togi; probably ashidome (stalling/delaying). Referent unclear: enemy or the arriving unit.

rows.en: Friendlies? Trust my skills, will you! Geez...
You bastard! You'll pay for that!
Don't screw with me!
Yeah! Mission complete!
Phew. Looks like I'll make my date on time.
Luck's part of skill, you know.
It's over already? Aw, why?
Did I take it too easy?
Aaagh. That's it for today. Dismissed.
I don't buy it.
Let's forget about what's past.
Hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey!
Don't hold back, blast away!
Blow a hole through 'em!
rows.notes: Target gender not settled; kept plural 'em.

rows.en: Keep your distance! Return fire!
Come on, go with your fists! Fists!
Charge in! I'm leaving it to you!
Knock 'em flat!
rows.notes: Target gender not settled; kept plural 'em.

rows.en: Stay here, got it?
Dodge every shot. Easy, right?
rows.notes: Transcript reads maedan (front shot); probably zendan (every shot).

rows.en: That's my date. Hands off.
Go raise some hell!
Special attack, go!
Come on, partner, show me something good!
rows.notes: Drinking-party cheer 'show me your good side', turned into a combat cheer to the partner.

rows.en: Don't blame me for what happens!
Here I go!
Hah! If those are orders, I guess I have no choice.
Roger! Woo!
You got it!
Come on, get serious, Captain!
Captain... guess it's not my place to worry about you.
Take too many hits and you'll go to heaven, Captain.
You've gotta be kidding me!
The Captain got shot down? Bull, I don't believe it!
That's not like you. Not like you at all, Captain.
I don't wanna hear your weird song!
Huh? What's this? ...I'm pulling out!
Screw this. I'm going home.
Woo! Now that's one skilled captain!
I could pull that off easy too!
If Guld can do it, there's no way I can't.
Listen, you stay out of this, got it?
You're just dead weight, you know that?
Yeah, yeah, sortie time.
Alright, let's go shake things up.
Interesting. Let's do this.
Don't underestimate a master of recklessness!
Yoo-hoo!
Well, time to make some more scrap.
Keep up with me, now.
I trust your skills.
Trust my skills, okay?
I'll show you what a real pilot can do!
rows.notes: Transcript says 'pilot's abnormality' (ijou); probably a different word such as iji (pride) or a boast about pilot ability. Meaning guessed.

rows.en: Take a crap and go to bed, kid.
Okay, that's it. All done.
Aw, is that it already?
Nice work out there!
Looks like I'll make my date on time.
Today's favor is worth one lunch, okay?
rows.notes: Transcript says 'lyrics' (kashi); read as 'kashi' = a favor owed.

rows.en: Not bad, you.
Not bad at all! That was great!
Well then, shall we go have a drink?
rows.notes: 'ippai' read as 'a drink' rather than 'a lot'.

rows.en: Easy job.
Let's do it again next time, partner.
Rush like that and you'll ruin your skin.
Heh, if those are orders, I guess I have no choice.
I've got no time for that right now.
Bring it on. Let's go.
Shall we go, then?
Just follow behind me. That's all.
Sortieing with a beauty, how nice.
rows.notes: Transcript 'bijento'; read as bijin to (with a beauty). Line is for a female partner.

rows.en: Well, guess I'll go chase some skirt.
Yahoo! Excellent!
Let's go, lady!
All right! Wanna fly together? Whoo!
Your boy's in a great mood today!
